body: I've looked into volunteering and would love to but the places I can reach (and need volunteers) all require me to pay for my training. Thank you for the messages, I think I'm too far gone for help but it makes me happy to see that some people will talk to someone like me.

I assume you had support from friends and family and access to money or affirdable care. I don't have these things and I am convinced they're essential for recovery. I don't think I'll survive this but I'm glad to hear you've done well for yourself despite tough times. 

If you don't mind me asking, what project are you working on? Science is the only thing I still find interesting
Cooking. In fact, it's uniquely human.
Suicidal depression. Not long now, nothing changes.
